stories.title: Spagna, l’ex leader di Podemos Iglesias: “La casa può mobilitare, alle urne possibile una sorpresa”

en.title: Spain, former Podemos leader Iglesias: "Housing can mobilize, a surprise possible at the polls"
en.summary: The former Spanish vice prime minister suggests that continued mobilization, potentially including a general strike, could produce electoral surprises and calls for open primaries.

stories.title: La Corte d'Assise di Bergamo rigetta la richiesta di nuove analisi sui reperti

en.title: Bergamo Court of Assizes rejects request for new analysis on evidence
en.summary: A court in Bergamo has denied a defense request for additional DNA analysis on evidence from a mixed blood sample, with the defense team announcing they will appeal the decision.

stories.title: Caso Flydubai, la confessione del copilota: “Volevo il martirio per vendicare Gaza”

en.title: Flydubai case, copilot's confession: "I wanted martyrdom to avenge Gaza"
en.summary: A 29-year-old Omani copilot has confessed to attempting to crash a passenger flight with 174 people aboard, stating his motive was connected to Gaza.

stories.title: Italia-Turchia 3-1, Scamacca, Calafiori e Pio Esposito firmano la vittoria in Nations League

en.title: Italy-Turkey 3-1, Scamacca, Calafiori and Pio Esposito seal Nations League victory
en.summary: Italy defeated Turkey 3-1 in a Nations League match in Bologna, with goals from Scamacca, Calafiori, and Pio Esposito. Donnarumma made crucial saves late in the match as Italy moved to second place behind France.

stories.title: Il copilota, 'l'ho fatto per vendicare Gaza, volevo morire da martire'

en.title: The copilot, 'I did it to avenge Gaza, I wanted to die as a martyr'
en.summary: A copilot confessed to interrogators in the United Arab Emirates that he committed an act to avenge Gaza and sought to die as a martyr.

stories.title: Calcio: 6-2 alla Polonia, l'Italia Under 21 si qualifica agli Europei 2027

en.title: Football: Italy Under 21 qualifies for 2027 Euros with 6-2 win over Poland
en.summary: Italy's Under 21 team secured qualification for the 2027 European Championship with a decisive 6-2 victory over Poland in Pescara, topping their qualification group by goal difference.

stories.title: FlyDubai, il copilota: “L’ho fatto per vendicare Gaza. Volevo morire da martire”

en.title: FlyDubai copilot: "I did it to avenge Gaza. I wanted to die as a martyr"
en.summary: A 29-year-old Omani pilot confessed during questioning in the United Arab Emirates to motivations related to Gaza.

stories.title: Corte Bergamo rigetta la richiesta di nuove analisi sui reperti di Yara

en.title: Bergamo Court rejects request for new analysis on Yara evidence
en.summary: A court in Bergamo denied a request for additional testing of evidence, which had been submitted by the legal representatives of Massimo Bossetti.

stories.title: Yara, giudici rigettano la richiesta di nuove analisi. I genitori: “Evitare un caso Garlasco 2”

en.title: Yara case: judges reject request for new forensic analysis. Parents: "Avoid another Garlasco case"
en.summary: The Bergamo Court of Assizes rejected a request for additional forensic investigations submitted by Massimo Bossetti's legal team, while the victim's family opposed the new inquiries.

stories.title: Spagna, Sanchez va a elezioni anticipate: "Una maggioranza più ampia per piegare le élite"

en.title: Spain, Sanchez calls early elections: "A broader majority to bend the elites"
en.summary: The Spanish prime minister announced early elections for November 29, citing housing issues that prompted over half a million people to protest in Madrid and other cities.

stories.title: Sánchez: “Elezioni anticipate il 29 novembre. Spagna scelga tra avanzare o cedere all’ultradestra”

en.title: Sánchez: Early elections on 29 November. Spain must choose between progressing or surrendering to the far-right
en.summary: Spain's socialist leader called early elections for 29 November following a housing policy crisis. He stated that a broader progressive majority is needed, with polls showing far-right party Vox as the only party gaining support.

stories.title: Spagna, il premier Sanchez si dimette: “Elezioni anticipate, alle urne il 29 novembre”/ Video

en.title: Spain, Prime Minister Sanchez resigns: Early elections, to the polls on 29 November
en.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Sánchez announced his resignation and called early elections for 29 November after the Congress rejected two housing-related decree-laws. He cited the need for a stronger majority and criticized the opposition.

stories.title: Caro benzina, Fiere di Parma raddoppia lo smart working

en.title: Rising fuel costs, Parma Fairs doubles smart working
en.summary: Parma Fairs company expanded its smart working policy, allowing employees to work remotely an additional day per week beyond existing arrangements, in response to rising fuel prices.

stories.title: Italia numero uno al mondo nella costruzione di navi da crociere

en.title: Italy number one in the world in cruise ship construction
en.summary: Italy leads global cruise ship production, commanding 57 percent of worldwide orders from 2026 onwards and holding the top position in Europe for this sector.

stories.title: Caputi (Federturismo): «Alla nautica servono regole moderne non soldi»

en.title: Caputi (Federturismo): «Italian nautical sector needs modern rules, not money»
en.summary: The president of Federturismo stated that the Italian nautical industry and related tourism sector require modern regulatory frameworks rather than financial support.

stories.title: Ericsson, ritirati i 131 licenziamenti a Genova dopo l’intervento di Meloni

en.title: Ericsson withdraws 131 layoffs in Genoa following Meloni's intervention
en.summary: Ericsson reversed its decision to lay off 131 workers in Genoa, instead offering exit incentives lasting 48 months and relocating staff to other facilities of the Swedish multinational.

stories.title: Nucleare pulito, consegnato l’ultimo settore Ue del reattore a fusione Iter

en.title: Clean nuclear, last EU sector of Iter fusion reactor delivered
en.summary: Fusion for Energy, along with Ansaldo Nucleare, Westinghouse Electric Company, and Walter Tosto, completed a major sector component for the Iter fusion reactor project.
